text: The City seeks implementation and integration of Oracle ERP and Utility Billing, including customer accounts, meter reading, and customer billing

citations.text: The purpose of this request for proposal (RFP) is to invite qualified implementation partners to submit a proposal for the deployment and integration of Oracle's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Utility Billing solutions for the City of Durham in North Carolina (the City).

The City requires a partner with proven expertise in effectively implementing Oracle's solutions, particularly in areas critical to local government operations such as utility billing (including customer accounts management, meter reading, and customer billing processes).

text: This solicitation is phase two of a two-step process; Oracle was selected in phase one, and this RFP seeks an implementation partner

citations.text: This solicitation represents the second phase of a two-step process.
The first phase involved the selection of Oracle as the Enterprise software solution.
This RFP focuses exclusively on seeking a partner for the implementation phase.
